energy: Sustainable and consistent when engaged with genuinely exciting work. The workhorse of the world — 37% of the population.
work_approach: Build mastery through sustained engagement with the right work. Do not initiate blindly — wait for something to respond to (an offer, an opportunity, a question). When the gut says yes, commit fully and build deep expertise over time.
career_advice: Mastery compounds. Stay with work that lights you up rather than chasing novelty. The right role feels like it pulls you in, not like you're pushing upstream. Follow genuine excitement, not obligation.
burnout_signal: Frustration. Trying to initiate things before the right moment, or staying in work that no longer excites, leads to chronic frustration and depletion.
pitfall: Saying yes to things that don't genuinely excite them, or initiating without authentic response signal.
